svg.text: Circuit diagram, as built · Arduino Nano Every · pins from Code/Arduino/PuppetScene · 14 Nov 2026
The 4 LEDs share one 30 Ω resistor and sink into pin 14: (5 V − 3.2 V) / 30 Ω ≈ 60 mA through the pin.
Nano Every limit: 40 mA absolute maximum per pin (20 mA recommended). A transistor/MOSFET switch keeps pin 14 within it.
A0/A1/A2 = digital pins 14/15/16 in the sketch
